name: ast_grep
defaultDetail: Off
prerequisites: Enable astGrep.enabled; supported language parser. Parse failures are not clean no-match results.

name: ast_edit
defaultDetail: On
prerequisites: Supported language parser; previews require plain-text write to xd://resolve or xd://reject. Multi-file apply is not transactional.

name: bash
defaultDetail: On in live source; finite PTY off, service PTY on, launch.enabled on; enabled default reported from live source in the dossier, not an effective local configuration audit.
prerequisites: Host execution access. Finite timeout 300 s; async preserves deadlines. Named services reject async and supplied timeout; approval is not containment.

name: eval / Python
defaultDetail: Both on; Python interpreter prerequisite
prerequisites: Python interpreter for py; Bun for js. Separate retained kernels, not Jupyter; fresh-process resume does not restore variables.

name: notebooks
defaultDetail: File dispatch, not a separate execution tool
prerequisites: A valid .ipynb file. Editing preserves saved outputs and execution counts, which can become stale; it does not execute cells.

name: browser
defaultDetail: On if Eval enabled; browser/backend prerequisite
prerequisites: Eval enabled and usable browser/backend. Host operations request exec approval; allowed_domains is not a sandbox.

name: computer
defaultDetail: Off
prerequisites: Enable session-locally with /computer on; native platform capabilities and OS permissions. Desktop read_only is not arbitrary-code containment.

name: github
defaultDetail: Off; gh on PATH required
prerequisites: Enable github.enabled; gh on PATH and appropriate authentication. Individual issues/PRs use issue:// and pr://.

name: web_search
defaultDetail: On; usable search candidate required; enabled default reported from live source in the dossier, not an effective local configuration audit.
prerequisites: Usable configured search candidate; modelRoles.web and retry.fallbackChains.web determine sequential fallback. Open sources beyond snippets.

name: security_scan
purpose: Planned native review / explicit cloud scan
defaultDetail: Off; specific auth prerequisites
prerequisites: Enable security.enabled; native scanning needs supported OAuth/provider-owned auth. Explicit cloud operations require ChatGPT Codex OAuth; completion is not proof of security.

name: generate_image
defaultDetail: Off
prerequisites: Enable generate_image.enabled and a usable image model/provider. Zero image data can be a normal explained result.

name: tts
purpose: Generate an audio file from text
defaultDetail: Off
prerequisites: Enable speechgen.enabled and a speech model. Local Kokoro requires provisioned weights, uses tts.localVoice and writes PCM16 WAV, not MP3.

name: ida
defaultDetail: On gate, but absent without local idalib installation
prerequisites: Local licensed IDA installation shipping idalib; Python must import ida_domain and idapro. Database edits can autosave.

name: checkpoint / rewind
purpose: Retain investigation report, drop exploration context
defaultDetail: Off
prerequisites: Enable checkpoint.enabled; rewind requires a nonempty report. Rewinds context, not files, Git, processes or desktop state.

name: todo
defaultDetail: On in live source; additional registry/mode gating; enabled default reported from live source in the dossier, not an effective local configuration audit.
prerequisites: Available in eligible registry/session modes; normally parent-owned. Done is coordination state, not verification.

name: Role-backed custom agents
purpose: Separate a specialist's instructions from its concrete model assignment, including cross-model executor/reviewer setups. The role or agent name is not a safety boundary.
howToInvoke: Create .omp/agents/*.md or ~/.omp/agent/agents/*.md with name, description, a prompt body, and model:"@review"; define modelRoles.review in config.yml. Dispatch using the discovered agent name.
defaultDetail: Custom definitions are opt-in. Exact-name discovery is first-wins: nearest project OMP agents, user OMP agents, extension-package roots, supported Claude marketplace plugin agents, then bundled agents. task.agentModelOverrides defaults to {} and outranks frontmatter model candidates.
prerequisites: A valid definition and resolvable model role. main and sub are reserved names. Set tools explicitly when restrictions matter; a custom reviewer can shadow the stock reviewer, and the stock reviewer itself declares bash. The task wire schema has no per-item model field.

name: Task and sonic worker tiers
purpose: Choose a general-purpose multi-step worker or a strictly mechanical worker without treating assignment length as reasoning difficulty.
howToInvoke: Use the default task agent for general work or select agent:"sonic" for mechanical changes/data collection. Set task.agentModelOverrides by exact agent name; task.enableEffort optionally exposes lo/med/hi hints.

prerequisites: A discovered, enabled agent and available model. Explicit routing can replace declared models. task.enableLsp=false by default; enable it only when workers need LSP navigation.

name: Task workspace isolation
purpose: Separate parallel edits for controlled integration. Workspace isolation is not arbitrary-code, network, credential, or filesystem confinement.
howToInvoke: Enable task.isolation.enabled, request isolated:true on the task item, and select task.isolation.merge as patch or branch. task.isolation.apply controls automatic integration of successfully captured changes.
defaultDetail: omp 18.8.6: task.isolation.enabled=false, task.isolation.apply=true, task.isolation.merge=patch, and task.isolation.commits=generic. Failed capture or merge retains recovery artifacts.
prerequisites: Git and enabled task isolation. Plan mode rejects isolated workers. Headless task children run with yolo approval mode; explicit tool restrictions still matter.

name: Peer messaging and revival
purpose: Steer a context-bearing worker or request follow-up findings instead of starting a blank replacement.
howToInvoke: Write a message to agent://<id>; use agent://all for broadcast. Read history://<id> for transcript context. Message a parked worker to revive it.
defaultDetail: Completed task agents remain idle for follow-ups; task.agentIdleTtlMs=420000 parks them after seven minutes by default. Values <=0 disable parking. Parked workers can revive; hard-aborted instances are terminal.
prerequisites: A known agent identity and the write tool for outbound messages. Plan-mode workers have IRC disabled. Isolated workers retain their workspace when kept alive; do not assume hard cancellation is reversible.

name: Per-call structured output
purpose: Collect typed results for fan-in without confusing schema validity with factual correctness.
howToInvoke: Pass outputSchema and schemaMode to task. Eval helpers use schema and schemaMode, or Python schema_mode. Read parsed fields through agent://<id>/reports/0/data as appropriate.
defaultDetail: Schemas apply when supplied or inherited; task precedence is per-call outputSchema, then agent frontmatter output, then parent session schema. schemaMode defaults to permissive, which can retain invalid output with a warning after retries. strict fails instead.
prerequisites: A valid caller schema; invalid schemas fail preflight. Nested child IDs use dots, not JSON-path slashes. Strict shape validation does not establish that findings are correct.

name: Eval agents and staged waves
purpose: Compose background agent sessions into explicitly orchestrated dependency waves; this is a primitive for a DAG, not a built-in correctness guarantee.
howToInvoke: Inside eval, call agent(prompt, ...) to obtain handles; use wait(handles) for a wave barrier and pass upstream results or artifacts into downstream assignments. Retain failures with Python raise_errors=False or JavaScript raiseErrors:false when needed.
defaultDetail: Invoked explicitly; eval.py=true, eval.js=true, and async.enabled=true. Eval agent handles count against background-job capacity, not task.maxConcurrency. async.maxJobs=100.
prerequisites: An enabled eval runtime, discovered agent, available model, and background capacity. Workers start without the parent's history. wait(handles) returns all values in input order; the separate wait tool returns on an owned result, peer message, or interruption. Do not make a node wait on its descendant.

name: Reusable eval workpools
purpose: Process independent queued items with reusable specialist workers, or choose a fresh context for every item.
howToInvoke: Create workpool(...) inside eval; submit with .push and inspect .status or .peek. Use .close to close the pool. Configure eval.workpool.freshAgents for per-item fresh contexts.
defaultDetail: Workpools are explicitly created. eval.workpool.freshAgents=false, so workers normally reuse accumulated context. Each pool has its own live-worker cap; the first full drain closes the pool.
prerequisites: An enabled eval runtime, available worker definition/model, and capacity. Reuse carries context between items. There is no pool.wait(); leave eval and use the wait tool only when completely blocked.

name: Tool-free eval completions
purpose: Make independent one-shot proposal or synthesis calls without starting a full tool-using agent session.
howToInvoke: Inside eval, call completion(prompt, model="default"/"smol"/"slow", schema=...) using the helper's language-appropriate syntax.
defaultDetail: Only runs when invoked. The call is stateless, with no tools or conversation history. Completion and judgment requests share a separate fixed process-wide request semaphore rather than the task semaphore.
prerequisites: An enabled eval runtime and an available selected model. Supply all needed context in the prompt; use agent() when a real tool-using worker session is required.

name: Typed judgment and batch assessment
purpose: Ask rubric-based choice, bool, or score questions over candidate states. Typed answers are assessments, not calibrated accuracy guarantees.
howToInvoke: Use judge() for one state and judge_batch() for common questions over multiple states inside eval. Configure modelRoles.judge for judgment routing.
defaultDetail: Judgment runs only when invoked. modelRoles defaults to {}; the judge role can select judgment, tiny, or chat models. Its fallback candidates are sequential recovery choices, not concurrent voting members.
prerequisites: An enabled eval runtime and available judge-role model. Bool answers are probabilities, not language booleans; score answers use probability-weighted rubric level indices. A heterogeneous ensemble requires explicit orchestration and aggregation.

name: Kernel-defined tools for workers
purpose: Expose a controlled function/data interface to workers without copying the parent's kernel state into each child.
howToInvoke: Define a Python function with @tool or a JavaScript tool(fn, ...), then pass its registered name in the worker's tools list.
defaultDetail: eval.tools.enabled=true, with eval.py and eval.js also true. Functions must still be explicitly defined and shared. Calls execute in the parent kernel; child agents do not inherit its variables.
prerequisites: An enabled eval runtime and tools sharing, a registered function, and an allowed worker invocation. Plan mode rejects sharing eval-defined tools. Parent-kernel execution is not a sandbox.

name: Advisor and WATCHDOG review
purpose: Review transcript updates with another model and surface nits, concerns, or blockers. Advice is not approval, and a completed wait is not proof of a successful review.
howToInvoke: Set advisor.enabled=true and configure modelRoles.advisor. Use WATCHDOG.md for advisor-only priorities and WATCHDOG.yml for named advisors with their own tools, models, instructions, cadence, and backlog policy. agent-end plus syncBacklog:strict requests synchronous final review.
defaultDetail: advisor.enabled=false; reviewMode=turn, reviewInterval=1, syncBacklog=off, immuneTurns=3, maxNotesPerUpdate=4. Default investigative tools are read, grep, glob, and optionally recall. Child agents default to no advisor; task.agentAdvisor defaults to {}.
prerequisites: An available advisor model and enabled subsystem. An unset advisor uses explicit slow or its own strong-model chain, not simply the main model; invalid explicit assignments are not silently replaced. Explicit rosters may grant mutating tools and require trust. strict has no wall-clock cap, but abort/failure and documented stop conditions release waits.

name: Agent Hub and background jobs
purpose: Inspect the live or persisted team, read transcripts, see model/usage information, and supervise workers.
howToInvoke: Open Agent Hub with Alt+A for tree/activity views and steer, revive, or kill controls. Use /jobs and proc:// for managed background jobs. /agents manages definitions/settings; it is not the live Hub.
defaultDetail: Hub is opened on demand. async.enabled=true and async.maxJobs=100; task.showResolvedModelBadge=false means resolved model IDs are not shown in the task widget by default, distinct from Hub inspection.
prerequisites: An interactive UI for Alt+A and existing agent/job records. Advisor rows in the local Hub are observational, not messageable, revivable, or killable peers. Hard-aborted workers cannot be revived.

name: Model roles and role presets
purpose: Decouple workloads from concrete model choices using fifteen built-in roles and optional custom chat roles.
howToInvoke: Set modelRoles in config.yml and refer to roles as @role. Chat roles: default, smol, slow, vision, plan, commit, tiny, memory, task, advisor. Model-kind roles: image, web, speech, dictation, judge. Use modelPresets for named role/default-thinking snapshots.
defaultDetail: modelRoles={} and modelPresets={}; modelRoleStorage=global. Unset tiny resolves through smol and memory through tiny. Unset smol/slow inherit an explicit default before built-in priority lists. Preset switching persists assignments rather than merely changing a visual selection.
prerequisites: Available models of the appropriate kind and provider credentials. Put provider endpoints/metadata in models.yml, not role mappings. vision analyzes images; image generates them. Assigning plan does not enter plan mode. Prefer exact provider/model-id selectors when provider identity matters; availability is not proof of successful authentication.

name: Request fallback routing
purpose: Recover failed model requests without conflating role availability selection, per-request fallback, and context-window promotion.
howToInvoke: Configure retry.fallbackChains with exact provider/model-id, provider/*, live role, or default keys. Use retry.fallbackRevertPolicy to control return to the primary. Configure contextPromotionTarget separately and enable contextPromotion.enabled for explicit context promotion.
defaultDetail: retry.enabled=true, retry.modelFallback=true, retry.fallbackChains={}, retry.fallbackRevertPolicy=cooldown-expiry. retry.maxRetries=10, baseDelayMs=500, maxDelayMs=300000. contextPromotion.enabled=false; no model-name-derived larger-sibling chain is automatic.
prerequisites: Available fallback models. Routing precedence is exact model, provider wildcard, live role, then default. Model-kind roles never borrow the chat default chain; an explicit empty role chain disables fallback. Role candidate lists select first availability, while agent frontmatter candidates additionally form per-spawn primary/fallback chains. There is no agent:<name> fallback key. Entries without an effort suffix inherit the failing turn's thinking level.

name: Configuration profiles and overlays
purpose: Separate OMP profile state and apply process-local settings overlays without silently rewriting machine-wide policy.
howToInvoke: Select a profile with --profile or OMP_PROFILE (PI_PROFILE fallback). Supply --config overlays or PI_CONFIG_FILES. Use config.yml for role/settings mappings; modelRoleStorage:project limits role-assignment writes to the launch cwd's .omp/config.yml.
defaultDetail: Profiles and CLI overlays require selection. Settings priority is declared setting environment variable, runtime override, later CLI overlay, project, global, then defaults. Ordinary settings commands write global config; modelRoleStorage defaults to global.
prerequisites: Valid profile/overlay configuration. --profile wins over environment selection. Objects deep-merge, arrays replace, and named presets resolve as whole entries. Native project settings use the launch cwd's .omp, not an ancestor walk. Profiles isolate OMP settings/auth/sessions/caches, but project and enabled foreign discovery still apply. Credential precedence is separate; config list masks credentials, whereas explicit config get can reveal them.
